description: FAD-face charge under four truncation and confidence filters, benchmarked across reductases with known acceptors

# same as the previous block, with the b-factor field handled for both the experimental
# reference (list of per-atom B) and the transformed models (mean pLDDT)
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
THREE = {"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G",
         "HIS":"H","ILE":"I","LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S",
         "THR":"T","TRP":"W","TYR":"Y","VAL":"V"}
AAs = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62 = """ 4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
-1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
 0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
-1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
 1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
MM = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")], float)
idx = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(AAs)}; GAP = -8.0
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c, -1) for c in s])
def nw_pairs(s1, s2):
    a, b = enc(s1), enc(s2); n, m = len(a), len(b)
    Sub = np.where((a[:,None]>=0)&(b[None,:]>=0), MM[np.clip(a,0,19)[:,None], np.clip(b,0,19)[None,:]], -1.0)
    M_ = np.full((n+1,m+1), -1e9); M_[0,:] = 0.0; M_[:,0] = np.arange(n+1)*GAP; jj = np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        cand = np.full(m+1, -1e9)
        cand[1:] = np.maximum(M_[i-1,:-1] + Sub[i-1,:], M_[i-1,1:] + GAP); cand[0] = M_[i-1,0] + GAP
        M_[i,:] = np.maximum.accumulate(cand - jj*GAP) + jj*GAP
    i, j = n, int(np.argmax(M_[n,:])); pairs = []
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if abs(M_[i,j] - (M_[i-1,j-1] + Sub[i-1,j-1])) < 1e-6: pairs.append((i-1, j-1)); i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif abs(M_[i,j] - (M_[i-1,j] + GAP)) < 1e-6: i -= 1
        else: j -= 1
    return pairs[::-1]
def parse_pdb(txt, chain=None):
    res, het = {}, []
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[17:20] in THREE:
            ch = ln[21]
            if chain and ch != chain: continue
            key = (ch, int(ln[22:26])); res.setdefault(key, {"aa": THREE[ln[17:20]], "atoms": {}, "bl": []})
            res[key]["atoms"][ln[12:16].strip()] = np.array([float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])])
            try: res[key]["bl"].append(float(ln[60:66]))
            except Exception: pass
    for k in res: res[k]["b"] = float(np.mean(res[k]["bl"])) if res[k]["bl"] else float("nan")
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("HETATM"):
            het.append((ln[17:20].strip(), ln[12:16].strip(),
                        np.array([float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])])))
    return res, sorted(res, key=lambda k: (k[0], k[1])), het
def kabsch(Q, P):
    qm, pm = Q.mean(0), P.mean(0); H = (Q-qm).T @ (P-pm)
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(H); d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
    return Vt.T @ np.diag([1,1,d]) @ U.T, qm, pm
def apply(V, R, qm, pm): return (V - qm) @ R.T + pm

rres, rkeys, rhet = parse_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UMK.pdb", timeout=120).text, chain="A")
ISO = {"N1","C2","O2","N3","C4","O4","C4X","C4A","N5","C5X","C5A","C6","C7","C7M","C8","C8M","C9","C9A","N10","C10"}
iso = np.array([c for rn, an, c in rhet if rn == "FAD" and an in ISO])
rseq = "".join(rres[k]["aa"] for k in rkeys)
QF = {"R":1.0, "K":1.0, "D":-1.0, "E":-1.0, "H":0.1}

def run(ac, fit_start):
    info = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{ac}", timeout=120).json()[0]
    res, keys, _ = parse_pdb(requests.get(info["pdbUrl"], timeout=120).text)
    sub = [k for k in keys if k[1] >= fit_start]
    kept = [p for p in nw_pairs("".join(res[k]["aa"] for k in sub), rseq) if "CA" in res[sub[p[0]]]["atoms"]]
    for cut in [1e9, 12, 9, 7, 6, 5, 4.5, 4.0, 4.0]:
        Q = np.array([res[sub[i]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
        P = np.array([rres[rkeys[j]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
        R, qm, pm = kabsch(Q, P); d = np.linalg.norm(apply(Q, R, qm, pm) - P, axis=1)
        new = [kept[t] for t in range(len(kept)) if d[t] < cut]
        if len(new) >= 70: kept = new
    Q = np.array([res[sub[i]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
    P = np.array([rres[rkeys[j]]["atoms"]["CA"] for i, j in kept])
    R, qm, pm = kabsch(Q, P)
    rmsd = float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(apply(Q, R, qm, pm) - P, axis=1)**2).mean()))
    res = {k: {"aa": v["aa"], "b": v["b"],
               "atoms": {a: apply(c[None,:], R, qm, pm)[0] for a, c in v["atoms"].items()}} for k, v in res.items()}
    return res, keys, rmsd, len(kept)

def charge(res, keys, radius, start, plddt_min=None):
    tot, n, lp = 0.0, 0, 0
    for k in keys:
        if k[1] < start: continue
        b = res[k].get("b", float("nan"))
        if plddt_min is not None and not np.isnan(b) and b < plddt_min: continue
        A = np.array(list(res[k]["atoms"].values()))
        if np.sqrt(((A[:,None,:] - iso[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min() <= radius:
            n += 1; q = QF.get(res[k]["aa"], 0.0); tot += q
            if abs(q) >= 0.9 and not np.isnan(b) and b < 70: lp += 1
    return tot, n, lp

print(f"{'protein':16s} {'acceptor':14s} {'RMSD':>5s} {'full':>7s} {'>=95':>7s} {'>=105':>7s} {'pLDDT>=70':>10s}  n(14A)")
rows = [("hCYB5R3 (1UMK)", "cytochrome b5", 0.0,
         charge(rres, rkeys, 14, 1)[0], charge(rres, rkeys, 14, 30)[0],
         charge(rres, rkeys, 14, 40)[0], charge(rres, rkeys, 14, 1)[0], charge(rres, rkeys, 14, 1)[1])]
print(f"{rows[0][0]:16s} {rows[0][1]:14s} {0.0:5.2f} {rows[0][3]:+7.1f} {rows[0][4]:+7.1f} {rows[0][5]:+7.1f} "
      f"{'experimental':>10s}  {rows[0][7]}")
for nm, ac, acc, fs in [("Cbr1 yeast","P38626","cytochrome b5",40), ("Mcr1 yeast","P36060","cytochrome b5",55),
                        ("Pga3/Nqr1","Q12746","coenzyme Q6",70), ("Aim33","Q04516","unknown",70)]:
    res, keys, rmsd, npair = run(ac, fs)
    qa, na, lp = charge(res, keys, 14, fs)
    qb = charge(res, keys, 14, 95)[0]; qc = charge(res, keys, 14, 105)[0]
    qd, nd, _ = charge(res, keys, 14, fs, plddt_min=70)
    rows.append((nm, acc, rmsd, qa, qb, qc, qd, na))
    print(f"{nm:16s} {acc:14s} {rmsd:5.2f} {qa:+7.1f} {qb:+7.1f} {qc:+7.1f} {qd:+10.1f}  {na} "
          f"(low-pLDDT charged: {lp})")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.8))
x = np.arange(len(rows)); w = 0.21
cols = {"cytochrome b5": "#1f4e79", "coenzyme Q6": "#c00000", "unknown": "#e08a00"}
for off, i, lab, al in [(-1.5*w, 3, "full domain", 1.0), (-0.5*w, 4, "residues >= 95", 0.78),
                        (0.5*w, 5, "residues >= 105", 0.56), (1.5*w, 6, "pLDDT >= 70 only", 0.34)]:
    ax.bar(x+off, [r[i] for r in rows], w, color=[cols[r[1]] for r in rows], alpha=al, label=lab)
ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([r[0] for r in rows], rotation=18, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("net formal charge within 14 A of the isoalloxazine")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, ncol=2)
ax.set_title("FAD-face charge does not separate Aim33 from the cytochrome b5 reductases.\n"
             "Blue = known cytochrome b5 reductase, red = quinone reductase, orange = Aim33", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
